headline: Pakistan declared their first innings at 434-9 on day two of the first Test against Sri Lanka in Rawalpindi on Tuesday, after Saud Shakeel was out for 93.

card.desc: Rawalpindi Test ke doosre din Sri Lanka ke khilaf innings declare.

caption:
Pakistan ne 434-9 par innings declare kar di! 🏏
Dawn ke mutabiq Tuesday ko Rawalpindi mein Sri Lanka ke khilaf pehle Test ke doosre din Pakistan ne 106.3 overs mein 434-9 par apni innings khatam karne ka elaan (declare) kar diya. Saud Shakeel 93 runs par out ho gaye aur century se sirf 7 runs door reh gaye. Arafat Minhas ne 52 aur Ghazi Ghori ne 48 runs banaye. Sri Lanka ke Asitha Fernando aur Dilshan Madushanka ne 3-3 wickets liye.
Kya Pakistan yeh Test jeet sakta hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
